summary: All 3 new features verified end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest pass (added TestAISessions x2 for /api/ai/build-workout returning clean program_text + sessions[] with name/split_key/exercises[name,sets,reps,rpe,weight_lb], plus GET /api/ai/programs list items containing sessions field; and TestRankUp verifying finish-workout returns updated user.rank and promotes fresh Beginner → Intermediate across 500 XP threshold). Frontend: (1) Program-to-Logger — elite@test.com → open-athletes-center → BUILD → ai-generate → Claude returned in ~20s → 'send-to-logger' rendered → tap navigates to TRAIN with pre-filled ACTIVE session (Bench Press / Overhead Press / Incline DB Press with correct sets/reps/weights/RPE stepper values and finish-workout button); History tab 'send-hist-<program_id>' also loads the logger correctly. Program text shown to user is clean — no ===SESSIONS_JSON=== delimiter leak. (2) Rank-Up Fanfare — fresh registered user (Beginner, 0 XP) primed to 460 XP via API, then one UI finish-workout crossed 500 XP. PR modal fires first, then dismissing it reveals the RankUpCelebration modal (RANK ASCENSION · INTERMEDIATE · BEGINNER → INTERMEDIATE · CONTINUE / rankup-close). Tapping rankup-close dismisses cleanly. (3) Regressions: PR celebration still fires; workout logging awards XP and updates dashboard (elite 4200 XP LVL17); board-xp/board-strength/board-ratio tabs switch and show podium + rows over new background images without crashes; paywall shows Monthly $5.00 / Annual $39.99 with SAVE 33% badge. CRITICAL bug found and fixed in workout.tsx: `user` was not destructured from useAuth() but line 83 used `user?.rank`, so prevRank was always undefined and rank-up modal would never fire. Deprecated packages detected: none from expo-av/barcode/background-fetch. Non-blocking RN warnings still present (textShadow*, props.pointerEvents) — reported in prior iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Present in RankUpCelebration.tsx (styles.newRank uses textShadowColor + textShadowRadius) and other components; consolidate into single textShadow shorthand. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RankUpCelebration.tsx:30,53
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — repeated warning during first load. Move pointerEvents into the style object where used.

action_items: Optional cleanup only: migrate deprecated textShadow* style props to consolidated 'textShadow' and move pointerEvents into style objects.
critical_code_review_comments: workout.tsx L16 originally had `const { token, refresh } = useAuth();` while L83 used `user?.rank` — variable never destructured. This silently killed the rank-up modal trigger because prevRank was always undefined so `res.user.rank !== prevRank` compared to undefined and the modal fired inconsistently. Fixed by destructuring `user` as well. Recommend enabling `noUnusedLocals` / TS strict `noImplicitAny` or `no-undef` ESLint rule to catch such omissions.

workout.tsx finish(): PR modal (celebration) and RankUp modal both open in the same tick; on web the RankUp Modal renders behind the PR Modal. Users must dismiss the PR modal before seeing rank-up. Consider chaining: only setRankUp after PRCelebration onClose, or render RankUp modal at higher z-index / after a small delay if !pr_hit-only. Not blocking (spec confirms modal shows only when rank changes; the celebration does fire) but UX is slightly awkward on a workout that both PRs and ranks up.

backend /ai/build-workout correctly parses ===SESSIONS_JSON=== delimiter with regex fallback; program_text stripped of the delimiter before persistence and response. Robust against LLM returning no JSON (sessions defaults to []).
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/workout.tsx (destructured `user` from useAuth so rank-up modal can compute prevRank)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (program-to-logger from BUILD + HISTORY, rank-up modal, PR modal, leaderboards, paywall all pass)

seed_data_creation: Registered several throwaway rankup_* accounts for rank-up flow (Beginner→Intermediate). TestRankUp registers its own rankup_* user each run. Seed users (athlete/elite/freak) untouched by new suites (they still use fresh_token fixture where possible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs on the auth screen use `placeholder='Email'` and `placeholder='Password'` (no testIDs). Signup submit is the 'ENLIST' text button after switching to the ENLIST tab. Playwright `text=` selector must use quoted syntax not comma-combined. Fresh-user rank-up flow: use in-browser fetch (page.evaluate) to prime XP because CDN blocks urllib requests with 403; then log a workout via UI. PR modal (celebration) always opens on top of RankUp modal — dismiss PR first (text 'DISMISS') then rankup-close appears. New backend response shape for POST /api/ai/build-workout: {program_id, program_text (clean, no delimiter), sessions:[{name, split_key, exercises:[{name, sets, reps, rpe, weight_lb}]}]}. GET /api/ai/programs items also include sessions[].
rca_of_issue: Rank-Up modal wouldn't fire: workout.tsx L16 destructured only { token, refresh } from useAuth() but L83 referenced `user?.rank` to compute prevRank. Because `user` was an undeclared identifier, prevRank was always undefined, so the guard `prevRank && res.user.rank !== prevRank` was always false and setRankUp was never called. Fix: add `user` to the destructure on L16. Verified end-to-end via a fresh Beginner primed to 460 XP; one UI-logged workout produced +200 XP crossing 500 XP → Intermediate, and the RankUpCelebration modal correctly rendered with RANK ASCENSION / BEGINNER → INTERMEDIATE and dismissed via rankup-close.
